_comment: Human-owned exceptions to the grounding gate (check-related-pages-grounding.py). Each entry is a connection that is genuinely public but not restated as prose on the linking page, reviewed and cleared by Lucas. hub_targets: overview/utility pages any page may link. public_names: NOT_YET_PUBLIC entities whose name is public (only their page is withheld). pages: per-page target exceptions with reasons.

public_names.oldblood: the term 'oldblood house' denotes an ancient holy bloodline and is long-standing public lore across the Miracles and Houses pages; the gm-only oldblood.md page holds the SECRET of what oldblood truly is. The public term is not the withheld concept, so its appearance in public prose is not a leak (2026-08-19, faeries->aetheris / oldblood migration).
public_names.Sombral Spade: Andaluria's people's monster-hunter order, openly named on the public Andaluria page; the sombral-spade.md page is withheld only because its leader's secret nature is not yet public (Lucas, 2026-08-19).
public_names.The Council of Five: Andaluria's visible reconstruction government, named on the public Andaluria page; the-council-of-five.md is withheld because the SECRET (that they are the corrupted Fallen Houses) stays gm-only, not because the council's existence is hidden (Lucas, 2026-08-19).
public_names.Novak Azimuth: the young head of House Azimuth is openly named across the public family pages (mother Cornelia, grandmother Zhenya, sisters, uncle Lorkhan) and the index; novak-azimuth.md is withheld only because it holds his secret designs on the crown and his concealed-PC identity, not because his existence is hidden (Lucas, 2026-08-27).
public_names.Parashiel: the Miracle of Parashiel is publicly named on Miracles and the House Azimuth page as 'a Miracle shrouded in mystery'; parashiel.md is withheld because its TRUE nature (the familiars, the avatar, the Rule of The Divider, Cornelia's melding) stays gm-only, not the name (Lucas, 2026-08-27).
public_names.Castorius Voldis: Prince Castorius, who renounced his claim in the Lodestar Pact and passed out of the record, is public historical lore on Castus Voldis, House Voldis, and the Lodestar Pact; castorius-voldis.md is withheld because the SECRET (that he is the immortal Stargazer/Lodestar) stays gm-only (Lucas, 2026-08-27).
public_names.Nikta: the Great Owl, Shepherd of the Seasons, is a publicly-named Faunus on the-faunus.md and witherwild-continent (the Wickling faith's reconstructed gods are public knowledge); nikta.md is withheld only because the Reaping-Eye theft cosmology stays gm-only, not the name (2026-09-03).
